results.summary: This design implements a simple sprinkler controller whose output depends on four input conditions: rain, water supply, soil moisture and time of day. The sprinkler is enabled only when the water supply is sufficient and the soil is dry within the watering period, with the logic documented as a truth table in the README. It is tested by toggling inputs A through D and observing two LEDs that indicate the sprinkler state and water supply. No external hardware is required, and it appears to be a beginner-level Wokwi logic exercise.

This design drives a 7-segment display so that entering the value 201 in binary on the inputs lights the segments to form the letter A. The pin names are simply the fixed logic values 1 and 0 for each input and output, reflecting a hard-wired pattern rather than a general decoder. It is tested by running the design and adjusting the inputs if needed. No external hardware is required, and the project is a first Wokwi exercise by the author.
